title: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Matnei
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rabbi Yochanan’s student and is mentioned only once, in Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:11: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Matnei was leaning on Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman explains that he attended Rabbi Yochanan and accompanied him. They reached the Boule statue, and he asked whether they might pass before it. Rabbi Yochanan replied, “Pass before it and blind its eyes.”

notes.text: The complete Jerusalem Talmud paragraph has Matana rather than the notice’s Matnei. Its wording says Yitzchak leaned on Yochanan; Hyman glosses the relationship as attendance and accompaniment. The reply about blinding the statue’s eyes is retained as a quotation.
